_meta.name: supabase-local
_meta.description: Local Supabase MCP via the built-in HTTP/SSE endpoint at /mcp. Official approach for local instances — uses mcp-remote to bridge stdio to the HTTP endpoint.
_meta.api_key_source: Run `npx supabase status` from project dir — use the 'Secret' key value
_meta.note: Key goes in --header arg via mcp-remote. Claude Code does not expand env vars in args, so deploy script writes the value at deploy time. File is machine-local and not git-tracked. Key rotates with `supabase stop && supabase start` — run `mcp-deploy --server supabase-local --force` after updating SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN.
